derivation: Per-source entity floors for the deploy.yml 'Verify harmonized output'
gate. Regenerated 2026-08-07 from one reviewed full 15-source harvest
on ammitto/ammitto main 3db2e4e — the exact SHA deploy.yml pins, with
NO branches applied — over fresh shallow clones of all 15 data-*
repositories (every SHA recorded in data_repo_commits below, the field
earlier revisions of this file lacked). Each source was first
harmonized ALONE so no failure masked another, then one combined run
produced the artifact tree the gate actually reads. This regeneration
replaces the 2026-08-05 revision, whose own composition_note declared
its jp floor and total a forbidden hand-tune; that debt is cleared.
THE FLEET CHANGED: the data-repo gitignore fix landed, so
data-au/ca/ch/us/un/eu/uk/nz/tr/wb now carry full committed processed/
corpora. ca, ch, un and us move from pending to publishing. ch's

Two derivation classes:
1. measured (the 13 publishing sources): floor(count * 70 / 100) in
INTEGER arithmetic — binary floating point makes
floor(1370 * 0.70) evaluate to 958 in jq 1.6 while the exact value
is 959, so regenerate with integers or the floors drift by one.
Every floor here was computed twice (jq and bash $((count*70/100)))
with identical results. 70% tolerates normal delisting churn while
still failing on partial-source loss.
count is the source's entities value in the COMBINED run's
stats.json, because that is the exact number the verify gate
compares against the floor. Combined counts are post-deduplication
and depend on the source order of the harmonize command: an entity
already claimed by an earlier source is not recounted for a later
one. Three sources therefore measure lower combined than solo:
ca 5576 vs 5684 solo, cn 322 vs 323 solo, jp 5097 vs 7980 solo
(jp's announcement-ingested records overlap heavily with the
earlier eu/un/us lists). The other ten measure identically solo
and combined. All 13 exit 0 both solo and combined.
2. provisional (ru un_vessels): both harvest exactly 0 — ru's
processed/ is empty ('No YAML files found') and un_vessels has no
input directory at all ('No input directory found'); their data-repo
PRs are unmerged. Solo runs confirm both exempt cleanly at 0 under
--allow-empty. Their floors carry forward the 2026-07-29 provisional
derivation, floor(March-committed api/v1 count * 35 / 100) in the
same integer rule (ru 698, un_vessels 11), unchanged because their
inputs are unchanged. These floors are deliberately unreachable and
are never compared while the source is pending: the pending gate
below holds each at exactly zero instead.
jp stays publishing on gem-side announcement ingestion alone (on main
at the pinned SHA); its unmerged data-jp PR is not required for its
5097 combined entities. tr measures 276 (grew from 275), eu 6329
(grew from 5860), uk 6349 (grew from 5738); every floor below is
recomputed from this harvest, no value is inherited from the previous
measured class.
total_entities_floor = floor(60901 * 70 / 100) = 42630, where 60901 is
the combined run's total_entities — which equals both the sum of the
13 per-source combined counts and the deduplicated search-index row
count of the same run.
measured_entity_counts is documentation only; the workflow reads
source_floors and total_entities_floor.
